_about: Public-domain Ezra Stiles (1727-1795), president of Yale College, for the Word Hoard: A Discourse on the Christian Union (Boston, 1761), The United States Elevated to Glory and Honour (second edition, Worcester, 1785), A History of Three of the Judges of King Charles I (Hartford, 1794), The Literary Diary edited by Franklin Bowditch Dexter (1901, three volumes) and the Extracts from his Itineraries (1916), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 39 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

stiles-christian-union-1761: A Discourse on the Christian Union (Boston: Edes and Gill; catalogued 1761)
stiles-united-states-elevated-1785: The United States Elevated to Glory and Honour, second edition, corrected (Worcester: Isaiah Thomas, MDCCLXXXV)
stiles-three-judges-1794: A History of Three of the Judges of King Charles I (Hartford: Elisha Babcock, 1794)
stiles-literary-diary-1: The Literary Diary of Ezra Stiles, vol. I, ed. Franklin Bowditch Dexter (New York: Charles Scribner's Sons, 1901)
stiles-literary-diary-2: The Literary Diary of Ezra Stiles, vol. II, ed. Franklin Bowditch Dexter (New York: Charles Scribner's Sons, 1901)
stiles-literary-diary-3: The Literary Diary of Ezra Stiles, vol. III, ed. Franklin Bowditch Dexter (New York: Charles Scribner's Sons, 1901)
stiles-itineraries-1916: Extracts from the Itineraries and Other Miscellanies of Ezra Stiles, 1755-1794, ed. Franklin Bowditch Dexter (New Haven: Yale University Press, MDCCCCXVI)

_excluded.stiles-other: Kohut's Ezra Stiles and the Jews (1902, a selection by another hand); other Stileses
